record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.context_brief: Representation theory for Calabi-Yau N=2 VOAs
record.original_question: If N=2 vertex operator superalgebras corresponding to Calabi-Yau manifolds can be constructed, can one develop their representation theory and use it to construct the corresponding N=2 superconformal field theories, including operator product expansion for intertwining operators, modular invariance, modular tensor categories in a suitable sense, and full N=2 superconformal field theories?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.2. If N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras corresponding to Calabi-Yau manifolds can be constructed, study the representation theory of these N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras. Use this representation theory to construct the corresponding N = 2 superconformal field theories, including the proof of the operator product expansion of intertwining operators, the proof of modular invariance, the construction of modular tensor categories (in a suitable sense), and the construction of full N = 2 superconformal field theories.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. A vertex operator superalgebra is a $\mathbb{Z}/2$-graded vector space $V=V^{\bar 0}\oplus V^{\bar 1}$ equipped with a vacuum vector, a conformal vector of central charge $c$, and a state-field correspondence $Y(\cdot,z):V\to(\mathrm{End}\,V)[[z,z^{-1}]]$ satisfying the usual super-locality, vacuum, translation, and Virasoro axioms. An $N=2$ superconformal vertex operator superalgebra of central charge $c$ is such a $V$ containing four distinguished fields — the Virasoro field $L(z)$, two odd primary fields $G^{\pm}(z)$ of conformal weight $3/2$, and an even primary $U(1)$-current $J(z)$ of weight $1$ — whose modes generate the $N=2$ superconformal algebra
$$[L_m,L_n]=(m-n)L_{m+n}+\tfrac{c}{12}(m^3-m)\delta_{m+n,0},\quad [J_m,J_n]=\tfrac{c}{3}m\delta_{m+n,0},\quad \{G^+_r,G^-_s\}=2L_{r+s}+(r-s)J_{r+s}+\tfrac{c}{3}(r^2-\tfrac14)\delta_{r+s,0},$$
with the remaining standard commutation relations. Suppose that to every compact Calabi-Yau manifold $X$ (i.e., a compact Kähler manifold with vanishing first Chern class, equipped with a Ricci-flat Kähler metric) there is associated such an $N=2$ vertex operator superalgebra $V_X$ of central charge $c=3\dim_{\mathbb{C}} X$, encoding the geometric data of $X$ in a way compatible with the chiral de Rham/Witten genus construction.

Problem. Assuming the existence of $V_X$ for Calabi-Yau manifolds $X$:
(a) Develop the representation theory of $V_X$: classify a suitable category $\mathcal{C}(V_X)$ of (admissible/grading-restricted generalized) modules, and determine its basic structural properties (semisimplicity or finiteness conditions analogous to $C_2$-cofiniteness, rationality, fusion rules).
(b) Prove that the products of intertwining operators among modules in $\mathcal{C}(V_X)$ converge and admit operator product expansions, equipping $\mathcal{C}(V_X)$ with a vertex tensor category structure.
(c) Prove modular invariance for the (suitably defined) genus-one correlation functions and characters built from intertwining operators.
(d) Construct, in an appropriate sense (possibly relaxing rationality and allowing supercategorical, non-semisimple, or logarithmic enhancements), a modular tensor category structure on $\mathcal{C}(V_X)$.
(e) Using (a)–(d), construct the full $N=2$ superconformal field theory associated with $X$ — including a consistent assignment of bulk and boundary correlators on all Riemann surfaces satisfying sewing/factorization and modular covariance.
artifact.category_tag: N=2 vertex operator superalgebras and Calabi-Yau CFTs
artifact.status_search_result: No source indicates that this program has been carried out. While the representation-theoretic / modular tensor category framework for vertex operator algebras is well developed in the rational case (Huang) and extended to vertex operator superalgebra extensions (Creutzig–Kanade–McRae), the construction of $N=2$ vertex operator superalgebras associated to general Calabi-Yau manifolds and the development of their representation theory, OPE for intertwining operators, modular invariance, and modular tensor category structure leading to full $N=2$ superconformal field theories remains an open program.

status_evidence.title: From the representation theory of vertex operator algebras to modular tensor categories in conformal field theory
status_evidence.snippet: The representation categories of suitable (rational) vertex operator algebras form modular tensor categories.
status_evidence.claim: The general framework exists in the rational case but is not carried out for VOAs of Calabi-Yau type.

status_evidence.title: Tensor categories for vertex operator superalgebra extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Tensor-categorical structure for extensions of vertex operator superalgebras is established.
status_evidence.claim: Tensor-categorical tools for VOSA extensions exist but the Calabi-Yau N=2 case is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Representation Theory, Calabi–Yau Manifolds, and Mirror Symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Ongoing research program at the interface of representation theory and Calabi-Yau geometry.
status_evidence.claim: Active ongoing research, indicating the problem remains open.
